purpose: Cross-device reference. NOT part of the iphone-01 longitudinal dataset.

nameplate.source: manufacturer specifications supplied with the device

energy_consistency: battery_energy_wh = 3.83V x 3110mAh = 11.911 Wh ~ 11.91 Wh. cell_energy_wh / rated capacity = 3.865 V, 0.035 V above nominal.
vac_voltage_limit_note: iOS 15.1 aggregate set has no VacVoltageLimit record. MaximumPackVoltage = 4449 mV is a lifetime peak, not the configured software target.
prediction_basis: Same 4.45 V nameplate as reference-01 (measured 4340 mV at 1420 cycles) and this device's MaximumPackVoltage = 4449 mV ~ 4450 mV top rung. The ladder itself is NOT measured on this device.
battery_status: Original, never-replaced battery, confirmed on the device. OriginalBattery=0 has unconfirmed semantics (only null/1 are documented publicly); BatterySerialChanged=False is consistent with an original battery.
caveats: OriginalBattery = 0 must NOT be read as 'replacement battery'. That inference was withdrawn; see docs/corrections.md.

NCC/nameplate (71.13%) is LOWER than Apple's MaximumCapacityPercent (67) is above it: the implied Apple baseline is 3301 mAh, 6% above the 3110 mAh nameplate. This sign reversal is currently unexplained and is device-dependent, not simply age-related.

Two analytics files were supplied for this device: Analytics-Daily (70 records, no gauge data) and Analytics-Never (355 records, one BatteryConfigValueHistogram_Final). Neither contains VacVoltageLimit.
Raw .ips files are not published (contain crashreporter_key, incident_id, UUIDs and other identifiers).
